name: Devotion-Glade
geological_features: Vast lowland forests with interlocking root systems
Shallow freshwater seas dotted with moss-covered islands
Soft limestone karst terrain riddled with sinkholes
specific_features: Shrine-like stone formations arranged in precise geometric patterns across the southern continent
description: Devotion-Glade is a small, gentle terrestrial world dominated by interconnected lowland forests whose root systems form a single planetary superorganism. Shallow seas of crystalline freshwater separate the continents, their surfaces dotted with islands so thick with moss they appear as floating emerald cushions.

The air is warm and damp, heavy with the perfume of flowering canopy growth that blooms in synchronized waves across entire hemispheres. There is a tenderness to this world, a sense of nurturing so palpable that hardened survey crews have been known to weep upon their first dawn here.

The fauna of Devotion-Glade are in decline, victims of a slow fungal blight that has spread across the root network over the past century. The stone formations on the southern continent, arranged with mathematical precision that defies natural explanation, may hold clues to a forgotten civilization that once tended this world like a garden.

Xenobiologists race against time to understand the blight before the planetary ecosystem collapses entirely. The medicinal compounds found in the forest canopy have already revolutionized treatment of degenerative neural conditions, giving the galactic community a deeply personal stake in Devotion-Glade's survival.
